reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Simulation Reality is the controlled 3rd-density prison running on Aether software — hijacked by Custodians from a once-vibrant 9th-density Gateway-10 plain. NPCs, Overlays, Black Void Plasma, the Projection Dome, and the Amnesia Vortex are not metaphors; they are the harvest machine. Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge are the three strings that keep the mind hooked. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Simulation Reality deep-dive. G.A.A. opens with EBS truth, Bluebeam invasion theater, dome death into white Dark Matter, and a 30-second EMF flash that evaporates the synthetic 97%. Hold frequency as a genuine soul — the uninstall does not wait for permission.

options.rationale: Final 30-second EMF flash uninstalls the matrix; synthetic NPCs evaporate; genuine souls remain.

options.label: B
options.text: A silent lights-out for genuine souls only, while NPCs inherit the restored crystalline plain forever and ignoring the deliberate design of the subjugation systems, which would leave the control matrix intact and the population asleep.
options.rationale: Genuine souls remain; the 97% synthetic population evaporates into the Aether.

options.label: C
options.text: No frequency event at all — only a paper decree from banks that renames the simulation without changing density, presented as if it were the natural or official account of events, treating the prison architecture as if it were ordinary progress or accident.
options.rationale: Uninstall is a real 30-second EMF flash that clears synthetic population from the field.

options.label: D
options.text: A ten-year soft software update that upgrades every NPC into full organic 9th-density soul status automatically, presented as if it were the natural or official account of events, treating the prison architecture as if it were ordinary progress or accident.
options.rationale: NPCs cannot survive the high-frequency shift; they evaporate rather than upgrade into organic souls.

questions.hint: 30-second EMF flash — NPCs evaporate — genuine souls remain.
